D/ [--]IVN NOB C ; R/ [GLORIA EXERC] ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17; chipped. Obverse description: bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers, one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERC] ITVS. Diameter: 14.8mm, Weight: 1.28gms, die axis: 6
